content.what_it_is: Two GLOBAL-state solver routines. `ESTIMATE_HUV` advances free surface and depth-integrated momentum with stage coefficients, flux divergences, source terms, wavemaker mass injection, optional vessel flux, spherical metric additions and eta limiting, then calls the diagnostic/elliptic reconstruction (L52-L290). `GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV` forms total depth, constructs x- and y-direction tridiagonal systems for dispersive velocity, handles coupling/wavemaker boundaries and periodic y solves, falls back to algebraic velocity when dispersion is off, masks dry cells, and applies a Froude-number cap (L304-L541).
entities: SUBROUTINE ESTIMATE_HUV(ISTEP) at L53; GLOBAL at L54 and optional VESSEL_MODULE at L57
ESTIMATE_HUV integer INTENT(IN) ISTEP at L60
ESTIMATE_HUV real(SP) PARAMETER n_left, n_right, n_bottom, n_top at L61
ESTIMATE_HUV real(SP) flux/source scalars at L62; R1/R2/R3 arrays over Ibeg:Iend,Jbeg:Jend at L63; xmk/ymk at L65; DXg/DYg at L67; integer kf/kd at L69
SUBROUTINE GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV at L304; GLOBAL at L305
GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV real(SP) scalars Fr,Utotal,Utheta,dep,depl,depr,reta,retal,retar at L308 and arrays myA,myC,myD,myF at L309

unresolved: The nominal zero-pivot guards are ineffective for active cells. Both x and y systems test `tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK(I,J).GT.0` at L391 and L468, then divide by tmp2 at L392-L394 and L469-L471. When MASK>0 and tmp2==0, the OR condition is true and all three divisions are singular; the zero-coefficient ELSE branch is reached only when tmp2==0 and MASK<=0.

The y-direction coupling boundary dispatch repeats the same predicate: `IF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)` at L455 followed by `ELSEIF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)` at L459. The second branch, which applies the Jend/V(I,J+1) correction at L460-L461, is unreachable and appears to be a copy/paste error where a north-domain predicate was intended.

For non-CARTESIAN builds, wavemaker coordinate spacing is fixed from DX(1,1),DY(1,1) at L75-L78 and wavemaker continuity branches use those scalars throughout L89-L190, whereas the no-wavemaker branch uses DX(I,J),DY(I,J) at L203-L205. The accuracy/units assumption for a spatially varying grid inside a wavemaker is not documented.

GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV has IMPLICIT NONE at L307 but uses I, J and tmp1/tmp2/tmp3/tmp4 throughout L340-L474 without local declarations. They must be supplied by `USE GLOBAL` or compilation fails; if supplied, loop and scratch state is module-associated rather than local, with reentrancy/thread-safety consequences not explained here.
ISTEP directly indexes ALPHA and BETA in all stage updates at L223-L282, but this file does not constrain ISTEP to the allocated coefficient range.
The Froude test divides Utotal by Fr at L522. Fr is based on `sqrt(GRAV*Max(H,MinDepthFrc))` at L521; positivity of imported GRAV and MinDepthFrc is assumed but not checked here.
Declared ESTIMATE_HUV names WK_Source, kf and kd at L62/L69 are used only in commented-out wavemaker code at L105-L112, so their retained interface intent is unclear.
